summary: Foremost Clean Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting shares issued to Denison Mines under an existing Investor Rights Agreement. Denison exercised equity participation rights from a previous bought-deal flow-through placement, purchasing 137,590 common shares at $2.44/share for $335,720 total. Post-issuance, Denison holds ~15.8% of Foremost shares plus 607,600 warrants. The proceeds fund Athabasca Basin uranium exploration. This is a routine contractual issuance, not a special-situation event.
